title: introduce-external-dependency-cost-latency-correlation-and-attenuated-alerting
text:
introduce-external-dependency-cost-latency-correlation-and-attenuated-alerting

release_notes:
Add correlation dashboard and attenuated alerting: links token-cost spikes to external dependency latency and introduces a noise-reducing alert quieting scheduler. Minor telemetry tag additions and migration script included.

description:
Motivation: We frequently see token-cost or latency alerts that are actually downstream dependency issues (third-party APIs, customer DBs, internal feature flags). Those generate noisy cost/latency alerts that wake on-call but don't represent a regression in our serving runtime. This PR implements an observability-first mitigation: join token-level cost/latency telemetry with external-dependency traces to produce a correlation signal, surface that in a dashboard, and use it to attenuate (quiet) alerts probabilistically when external dependency correlation exceeds a threshold.

Summary of changes: 1) Trace & metric enrichment: add new span attributes and metric labels for dependency.namespace, dependency.host, dependency.latency_bucket; enrich invocation traces with observed outbound dependency spans. 2) Correlation service: lightweight pipeline to compute per-invocation correlation score between token-cost spikes and external dependency latency anomalies (moving-window statistical test + simple causal heuristics). 3) Dashboard: a cost-latency correlation matrix (tenant x dependency) with time-series overlays and quick-links to example traces. 4) Alerting: a new alert policy wrapper that consults the correlation signal and applies an attenuated alerting schedule (quiet for N minutes or escalate depending on score). 5) Migration/backfill: SQL migration to add new metric tags and a backfill job to annotate recent traces for historical analytics. 6) Tests & docs: unit tests for correlation heuristics, an e2e smoke test that simulates dependency degradation, and an oncall playbook describing how to interpret the dashboard and when to disable quieting.

Why this is different: existing tooling focuses on attributing cost to model/route/kernel; this change explicitly ties external dependency health to token-level cost and reduces operational noise by adjusting alert intent rather than suppressing signals blindly.

Operational concerns: cardinality of dependency tags is guarded by a whitelist and a deduping sampler to avoid metric explosion. Correlation computation runs in low-latency batch windows (1m) and emits a compact per-tenant signal to the observability store. Quieting is conservative by default (only applies to P3/P4 alerts) and requires manual opt-in for high-severity SLOs.

Rollout plan: staged rollout per-tenant. Step 1 (this PR) adds instrumentation and dashboard (no alerting changes). Step 2 (feature flag enabled for pilot tenants) enables attenuated alerts with a soft-fallback that still pages on repeated occurrences. Step 3 (wider rollout) makes quieting opt-in via tenant config.

Notes: related Linear tickets ENG-8675 (observability correlation MVP) and ENG-9042 (alert noise reduction). Support case SUP-342 requested quicker triage for token-cost spikes tied to partner outages.

review_comments:
Arjun Kapoor: Nice end-to-end thinking here. Two asks: (1) defend against high-cardinality hosts (we need a whitelist and hash-bucket sampler), (2) include a fallback so P0/P1 still page even if correlation is high.
Author (Maya): Added a dependency_whitelist config and a dedupe sampler. P0/P1 bypass quieting by default; updated attenuated_alert_wrapper.go accordingly.
Sofia Martínez: Add a smoke test that simulates our partner API returning 500s and ensure correlation score rises above threshold before quieting applies.
Author: Added tests/e2e/test_dependency_quieting.py. The smoke test runs in CI with local dockerized mock service and asserts quiet window created and tickets logged.
Ben Wallace: Suggest we expose per-tenant opt-out via Console. Can we add the feature-flag hook?
Author: Added feature flag check and Console feature toggle wiring placeholder; UX work tracked in ENG-9240.
CI Bot: unit tests failed on first run (race in correlation cache). Maya: fixed with mutex in correlation_worker.go and re-ran CI. All green now.
